title: Canonical integral sheet maps and pulled-back trace-image inclusion
statement: For commutative condensed coefficient rings R,S, a ring map a:R→S, a scheme map p:U→X, an S_X-module P, an R_U-module M and a specified scalar-extension isomorphism e:Ext(a_U)M≅p*P, construct two actual morphisms. For t:Y→U and g:Y→X with w:tp=g, the sheet embedding t*M→Res(a_Y)g*P is the pullback of latticeIntegralEmbedding followed by the inverse comapUpperStarIso and the composition comparison determined by w. For any τ:p_*p*P→P, construct g*image(latticePushedEmbedding;Res(τ))→Res(a_Y)g*P by pulling back the categorical image inclusion and applying the same coefficient comparison. The latter morphism is monic, with no finite-etale or freeness assumptions. Both are explicit composites, with no choice of data from an existence theorem.

def finiteEtaleLatticeSheetEmbedding (a : R ⟶ S) [IsMonHom a]
    {X U Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (P : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj S X))
    (p : U ⟶ X)
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology U) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj R U))
    (e : (Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap a U)).obj M ≅ (upperStar S p).obj P)
    (g : Y ⟶ X) (t : Y ⟶ U) (w : t ≫ p = g) :
    (upperStar R t).obj M ⟶
      (Mod.comap (coefficientMap a Y)).obj ((upperStar S g).obj P)
